pages.text: A Morris-Thorne wormhole: a throat of radius b₀ held open by exotic matter of negative energy, about b₀c²/2G of it. Cargo crossing it feels tides that grow with speed - go slowly through a wide throat.
$(thing)Set$(): Throat radius b₀, Transit speed, Exotic matter, Throat length.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Exotic-matter leakage: the throat needs M·(1 ± 2%·d).

$(thing)Limits$(): Not enough exotic matter: the throat pinches off; Tidal forces would shred the cargo; The throat frame is overheating.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A wider throat passes more cargo at once.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Exotic matter needed: M = b₀c²/(2G)$(br)Lorentz factor: γ = 1/√(1 − v²/c²)$(br)Tidal acceleration: Δa = γ²v²ℓ/b₀²$(br)Transit time: t = L/v
